seed: An operator must see every proposal, counterexample, source gap, provenance, risk, consequence and unknown before explicitly authorizing synthesis of a staged candidate, without the machine turning its beautifully self-referential compliance account into an ersatz human decision. Build an operator guide, a laboratory activation prompt, a human-only research submission form and a non-omissive machine-disclosed pre-synthesis dossier. Operahouse differs from Opera and Performer.

human_coordinates.what: Four human-consequential documentation artifacts for source-free Rulefield research
human_coordinates.who: Human researcher retains authorship and final authority; agent executes and discloses prospective plans
human_coordinates.where: Inside the portable packages/rulefield/operator/ tree, interoperable with the existing amendment receiver
human_coordinates.how: Full scientific evidence, three scannable disclosure depths, hash-bound source-free review, independent human authorization
human_coordinates.when: Pre-synthesis, after finite tests and before any staged candidate work
human_coordinates.why: Prevent source, scientific and permission laundering while enabling ambitious reproducible NKS exploration

commission_governance.note: A deterministic conductor receipt is an authoring process witness only; verify substantive source and executable paths separately.
